title: Caravel
summary: Combine encrypted Nostr conversations and confidential Ootle mainnet payments through Sapient in a browser. November 25, 2026: the live Caravel landing page explicitly identifies Ootle mainnet, matching the creator’s November 21 update in topic 276/22. Current README revision 189fb5e describes Nostr messaging and Sapient payments, including Android WalletConnect. The current app does not hold payment keys; the former embedded wallet, on-chain names and trading description is superseded. Desktop Chrome, Brave or Edge is recommended. The README walkthrough was captured with scripts and downloads disabled; no identity, wallet connection, message or payment was created. Separate historical Caravel Faucet, Burn Wallet and Trade templates retain their own network and availability evidence.
